commit.message:
Fix RUMMY+QG OOM on 80 GB H100; add measured RUMMY+QG results

The QG compute path allocates its GEMM scratch outside RUMMY's fixed
page/temp pool reservation, which fit the 96 GB RTX PRO 6000 it was
developed on but OOM'd on the 80 GB H100 (all three datasets, 2026-07-17).

- PipeGpuResources: clamp the page pool to available memory minus
  QG_POOL_RESERVE_GB (default 14 GiB); no-op on >=96 GB GPUs.
- run_all.sh: export QG_DIST_BUDGET_GB=4 (caps the largest scratch
  cudaMalloc at ~5 GB incl. growth slack); re-enable the RUMMY+QG loop.
- plot_end_to_end.py: parse measured RUMMY+QG logs instead of reusing
  RUMMY numbers.
- overall_billion.cu: fix stale sift10/sift100 dataset paths.
- results: measured RUMMY+QG logs + GPU-memory traces for DEEP1B and
  SIFT1B on the H100 (0.94-1.47x RUMMY, no OOM, peak 72.7 GB), plus the
  referenced RUMMY/AMG baseline logs and the Fig 19 RUMMY partial-copy
  emulation log.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
